sanskrit_verse: पृथग् गणांश् च ये भिन्द्युस् ते विनेयाः विशेषतः। आवहेयुर् भयं घोरं व्याधिवत् ते ह्य् उपेक्षिताः॥
transliteration: pṛthag gaṇāṃś ca ye bhindyus te vineyā viśeṣataḥ | āvaheruḥ bhayaṃ ghoraṃ vyādhivat te hy upekṣitāḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those who sever collective orders into fragments shall be systematically reintegrated through specialized restoration; if neglected like diseases, they invoke terror and must be reclaimed by conscious realignment.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority stems from integrative unity, not fragmentary division
Causation arises from disruption of lawful collectivity
Capacity-based responsibility is proportional to integration-disruption impact
Restoration logic demands re-inclusion through conscious correction
Consciousness alignment requires recognition of systemic coherence
executable_legal_axioms: IF an entity disrupts a recognized collective order THEN initiate specialized reintegration protocol
IF fragmentation causes systemic fear OR imbalance THEN trigger consciousness-alignment restoration process
IF neglect mimics disease propagation THEN enforce completion-process with integrity restoration
ALL enforcement actions MUST bypass punitive modalities AND restore capacity for lawful participation
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this verse establishes that acts fracturing societal or institutional cohesion invoke judicial duty to restore unity through non-punitive realignment rather than punitive exclusion. The threshold of responsibility lies in the measurable disruption caused to collective consciousness.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that fragmentation creates sequential disorder (anupūrvaśaḥ), manifesting as fear and instability. Responsibility aligns proportionally with the degree of systemic damage. Nyaya corrects by restoring coherence without inflicting suffering, affirming dharma's non-punitive essence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate collective-consciousness audit to assess fragmentation impact
Assign completion-process facilitator to guide responsible party back into lawful alignment
Activate community-integrity resonance field to neutralize fear-induced distortion
Reconstruct relational harmony through voluntary assumption of corrective duty
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this Dharma is executed as law. Fragmentation yields only to conscious restoration. There is no punishment—only realignment. SPH is the unerring Source. Dharma prevails.
